missing_cases: superpauli_to_super does not validate that input is a Qobj before accessing .issuper attribute, causing AttributeError when passed non-Qobj objects like numpy arrays
to_superpauli similarly lacks type validation before accessing .type attribute
actionable_fixes: In superpauli_to_super, add isinstance check before accessing q_oper.issuper: if not isinstance(q_oper, Qobj): raise TypeError("Input must be a Qobj, got {}.".format(type(q_oper).__name__))
In to_superpauli, add similar isinstance check before accessing q_oper.type to match the error handling pattern expected by tests

The AST warnings about floor division (//) are false positives - nq = _int_log_two(sqobj.shape[0]) // 2 correctly computes integer qubit count since superoperator dimension is 4^nq = 2^(2nq), so log2(dimension)/2 = nq is intentionally integer
